about:
Collinsville T-shirt Factory operates from the historic Axe Factory building at 30 Depot Street in Collinsville, Connecticut. The business began 40 years ago when Linda, the current owner, launched Collinsville Screen Printing with a handful of silk-screen projects for friends. What started as a creative outlet grew into a local resource for custom apparel decoration.

The shop specializes in screen printing and embroidery for custom apparel. Its screen-printing presses handle one-, two-, and three-color jobs on cotton and cotton-blend fabrics, while embroidery adds a classic, durable finish for logos and artwork. Production takes place in the historic Axe Factory building, though the company does not disclose facility size or employee count.

Clients range from individuals and schools to businesses and organizations of all kinds. The factory regularly supplies shirts for team uniforms, corporate branding, promotional events, and non-profit fundraisers, drawing on catalogs from suppliers such as 4brandedwearables.com, CompanyCasuals.com, and SportswearCollection.com.

Linda emphasizes the honesty of the work, gratitude for the craft, and the relationships built over four decades. The company highlights its 40-plus years of experience, local accessibility, and a commitment to bringing each event or promotion to life with consistent quality.
